title: Waxed Plants
description: Now you can wax plants! No more accidental griefing of your beautiful builds.
body:
**Now you can wax plants!**

This not only makes it more durable, but also ensures it always drops when broken.
No more accidental griefing of your beautiful builds.

**Features:**
- waxing 4 plants with honeycomb: grass, tall grass, fern, large fern
- waxed plants are durable as a dirt block 
- shears break waxed plants instantly
- any axe can unwax plants
- configurable amount of usages for honeycomb (0 = disabled)
